segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְלַד תּוֹדָה וּתְמוּרָתָהּ, וְלָדָן וְלַד וְלָדָן עַד סוֹף כׇּל הַדּוֹרוֹת — הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ כְּתוֹדָה, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁאֵין טְעוּנִין לֶחֶם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The offspring of a thanks offering and the substitute» of a thanks offering, and «the offspring» of the offspring and its substitute, «and the offspring of their offspring until the end of all time, they are» all «like thanks offerings,» with the «only» difference being «that they do not require» the accompanying «loaves,» unlike the thanks offering itself.

moves.summary: states the status of thanks-offering offspring and substitutes

positions.claim: offspring and substitutes of a thanks offering for all generations are like a thanks offering but do not require loaves
